items.source: Replace all placeholders of format ${name} with the value returned from the supplied PropertyPlaceholderHelper.PlaceholderResolver.
items.translation: 将所有格式为${name}的占位符替换为由提供的PropertyPlaceholderHelper.PlaceholderResolver返回的值。

items.source: Create a new PropertyPlaceholderHelper that uses the supplied prefix and suffix.
items.translation: 创建一个新的使用提供的前缀和后缀的PropertyPlaceholderHelper。

items.source: placeholderPrefix - the prefix that denotes the start of a placeholder
items.translation: placeholderPrefix - 表示占位符开始的前缀

items.source: placeholderSuffix - the suffix that denotes the end of a placeholder
items.translation: placeholderSuffix - 表示占位符结尾的后缀

items.source: value - the value containing the placeholders to be replaced
items.translation: value - 包含待替换占位符的值

items.source: the supplied value with placeholders replaced inline
items.translation: 用占位符替换后的提供的值内联显示。

items.source: Values for substitution can be supplied using a Properties instance or using a PropertyPlaceholderHelper.PlaceholderResolver.
items.translation: 替换值可以使用 `Properties` 实例或 `PropertyPlaceholderHelper.PlaceholderResolver` 提供。

items.source: A placeholder takes the form ${name}. Using PropertyPlaceholderHelper these placeholders can be substituted for user-supplied values.
items.translation: 占位符的形式为${name}。使用PropertyPlaceholderHelper，这些占位符可替换为用户提供的值。

items.source: Replace all placeholders of format ${name} with the corresponding property from the supplied Properties.
items.translation: 将格式为 `${name}` 的所有占位符替换为提供的 Properties 中的相应属性。

items.source: Create a new PropertyPlaceholderHelper that uses the supplied prefix and suffix. Unresolvable placeholders are ignored.
items.translation: 创建一个新的使用提供的前缀和后缀的PropertyPlaceholderHelper。无法解析的占位符将被忽略。

items.source: ignoreUnresolvablePlaceholders - indicates whether unresolvable placeholders should be ignored (true) or cause an exception (false)
items.translation: ignoreUnresolvablePlaceholders - 指示是否应忽略无法解析的占位符（true）或引发异常（false）。

items.source: valueSeparator - the separating character between the placeholder variable and the associated default value, if any
items.translation: valueSeparator - 占位符变量与其关联的默认值（如有）之间的分隔字符

items.source: escapeCharacter - the escape character to use to ignore placeholder prefix or value separator, if any
items.translation: escapeCharacter - 用于忽略占位符前缀或值分隔符（如果有）的转义字符

items.source: Juergen Hoeller, Rob Harrop, Stephane Nicoll
items.translation: Juergen Hoeller, Rob Harrop, Stephane Nicoll

items.source: Strategy interface used to resolve replacement values for placeholders contained in Strings.
items.translation: 用于解析字符串中占位符的替换值的策略接口。
